statements.name: receipt
statements.description: Declares the receipt template name.

statements.name: meta
statements.description: Defines template metadata such as width, paper profile, base font, and font scale mode.

statements.name: header
statements.description: Defines a first-class receipt header section.

statements.name: body
statements.description: Defines the main receipt body section.

statements.name: footer
statements.description: Defines a first-class receipt footer section.

statements.name: use
statements.description: Injects a reusable header or footer fragment resolved by the host app.

statements.name: left
statements.description: Prints left-aligned text.

statements.name: center
statements.description: Prints centered text.

statements.name: right
statements.description: Prints right-aligned text.

statements.name: text
statements.description: Prints text using the default left alignment.

statements.name: kv
statements.description: Prints a key/value row.

statements.name: divider
statements.description: Prints a divider line. Use an optional pattern and optional length.

statements.name: row
statements.description: Prints a table-like row using evenly spaced columns.

statements.name: table
statements.description: Declares a first-class table block that contains rows, loops, and conditions.
statements.snippet:
table:
  row "${1:ITEM}" "${2:QTY}" "${3:TOTAL}"
  for item in ${4:items}:
    row "{{item.name}}" "{{item.qty}}" "{{item.total}}"

statements.name: qr
statements.description: Prints a QR code block with optional size.

statements.name: barcode
statements.description: Prints a barcode. Formats: code128 (default), code39, ean13, ean8, upca and itf. Width and height are adapter units.

statements.name: image
statements.description: Prints an image/logo block with an optional width and height.

statements.name: spacer
statements.description: Adds one or more blank lines.

statements.name: if
statements.description: Conditionally renders a nested block when a path is truthy.

statements.name: for
statements.description: Iterates over a collection path and renders a nested block.

statements.name: bold
statements.description: Applies bold styling to a text or key/value statement.

statements.name: underline
statements.description: Applies underline styling to a text or key/value statement when the renderer supports it.

statements.name: small
statements.description: Uses the small receipt font on a text statement.

statements.name: big
statements.description: Uses the large receipt font on a text statement.

filters.name: upper
filters.description: Converts a rendered value to uppercase.

filters.name: lower
filters.description: Converts a rendered value to lowercase.

filters.name: default
filters.description: Uses a fallback value when the binding is empty.

filters.name: money
filters.description: Formats the value as money using the provided currency path or code.

filters.name: date
filters.description: Formats the value as a date. Defaults to dd/MM/yyyy. Optional args: output pattern, input pattern.

filters.name: datetime
filters.description: Formats the value as a date and time. Defaults to dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss. Optional args: output pattern, input pattern.

filters.name: maskPan
filters.description: Masks a PAN for safe receipt display.

filters.name: mask
filters.description: Masks any sensitive value. Args: showFirst, showLast, optional mask character. Examples: mask, mask:0,2, mask:2,4,"#".

filters.name: padLeft
filters.description: Pads a value on the left to the target width.

filters.name: padRight
filters.description: Pads a value on the right to the target width.

filters.name: padCenter
filters.description: Centers a value within the target width.
